newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-VIRENQUE BEATS ULLRICH TO LINE IN 14TH STAGE DUEL.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-VIRENQUE BEATS ULLRICH TO LINE IN 14TH STAGE DUEL.

text.p: Frenchman Richard Virenque, king of the mountains, beat overall leader Jan Ullrich in a superb duel for the 14th stage of the Tour de France on Sunday.
Virenque, second overall, and the German were given the same time for the 148-km stage from Alpe d'Huez, Ullrich's aggregate advantage remaining six minutes and 22 seconds.
"I'm extremely happy to have controlled this second Alpine stage and not lost any time in relation to Virenque," Ullrich said.
Defending champion Bjarne Riis of Denmark finished fifth, climbing one place overall to third, 11 minutes and six seconds behind Ullrich.
